title: Polymer Chain Growth Monte Carlo with Save/Load State
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js that implements a 3D interactive polymer chain growth simulation using a Monte Carlo lattice model with full save/load state capability.

## Scene Setup
- Use a dark background (0x0a0a1a). Set up a PerspectiveCamera at position (30, 25, 30) looking at the origin.
- Add ambient light (0x404060, intensity 0.4) and two directional lights: one white from (20,30,10) intensity 0.8, one blue-tinted (0xaaccff) from (-15,20,-10) intensity 0.4.
- Render a translucent wireframe cube (side length 20, centered at origin) representing the 3D lattice boundary. The lattice is a 21x21x21 integer grid from -10 to +10 in each axis.
- Use OrbitControls for camera interaction.

## Polymer Model
- Monomers are spheres (radius 0.35) placed at integer lattice sites. Bonds are thin cylinders (radius 0.08) connecting adjacent monomers.
- Each polymer chain starts at a random unoccupied lattice site near the origin (within ±3 of center).
- Chain growth uses a Monte Carlo self-avoiding walk (SAW): at each growth step, enumerate all 6 face-adjacent lattice neighbors of the chain's last monomer. Filter out occupied sites. If valid neighbors exist, pick one uniformly at random and add a new monomer there. If no valid neighbors exist, the chain is terminated (trapped).
- Color each chain with a distinct hue. Use HSL coloring: chain index i gets hue = (i * 137.5) % 360. Monomers use that hue at 70% saturation, 55% lightness. Bonds use the same hue at 60% saturation, 40% lightness.
- Track an energy value per chain: E = -epsilon * (number of non-bonded nearest-neighbor contacts between monomers of the SAME chain). Use epsilon = 1.0. A contact is when two monomers on the same chain that are NOT sequential neighbors along the chain backbone are at adjacent lattice sites.

## Simulation Controls
- The simulation runs in a step-by-step mode (not continuous). Each press of the SPACE key performs one growth step on the currently active chain.
- Press 'N' to start a new chain (max 5 chains). The new chain becomes the active chain.
- Press 'R' to reset the entire simulation to initial empty state.
- Press 'U' to undo the last growth step on the active chain (remove last monomer and bond). Minimum chain length is 1 monomer (the seed).
- Press 'A' to run 10 automatic growth steps on the active chain in rapid succession (with 80ms delay between steps for visual effect).

## Save/Load System
- A 'Save State' button (DOM) serializes the ENTIRE simulation state to a JSON string and stores it in window.__3D_SAVED_STATE__. The saved state must include: all chain data (lattice positions of every monomer, chain colors, active chain index, energy values), the occupied lattice map, and a step counter.
- A 'Load State' button (DOM) reads from window.__3D_SAVED_STATE__ and fully restores the simulation: clears all current 3D objects and rebuilds all chains from saved data. After loading, the simulation must be identical to when it was saved.
- Display save/load status in a small status bar at the bottom.

## HUD / UI
- Top-left HUD panel showing: total monomer count, number of chains, active chain index (1-based), active chain length, active chain energy, total system energy (sum of all chain energies), simulation step counter.
- Bottom status bar for save/load messages.
- Style buttons with a dark semi-transparent background, white text, positioned top-right.

## State Management (CRITICAL)
Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with these fields updated every frame or after every action:
- `totalMonomers` (number): total monomers across all chains
- `chainCount` (number): number of chains created
- `activeChainIndex` (number): 0-based index of active chain
- `activeChainLength` (number): monomer count of active chain
- `activeChainEnergy` (number): energy of active chain (negative or zero)
- `totalEnergy` (number): sum of all chain energies
- `stepCounter` (number): total growth steps performed across all chains
- `latticeOccupied` (number): count of occupied lattice sites
- `chainLengths` (array of numbers): lengths of each chain
- `chainEnergies` (array of numbers): energy of each chain
- `isTrapped` (boolean): whether active chain has no valid growth sites
- `lastAction` (string): last action performed, one of 'init','grow','new_chain','undo','reset','auto_grow','save','load'
- `savedStateExists` (boolean): whether window.__3D_SAVED_STATE__ is defined and non-null
- `autoRunning` (boolean): whether auto-grow sequence is in progress
- `undoCount` (number): total undo operations performed
- `chainPositions` (array of arrays): for each chain, array of {x,y,z} positions of monomers

All lattice coordinates must be integers in [-10, 10]. Energy must always be <= 0. totalMonomers must equal sum of chainLengths. latticeOccupied must equal totalMonomers. No two monomers may share the same lattice site.
physics_constraints: Self-avoiding walk: no two monomers may occupy the same lattice site. All monomer positions must be integers in [-10,10] range. Chain energy E = -(number of non-bonded same-chain nearest-neighbor contacts), always <= 0. Conservation: totalMonomers === sum(chainLengths) === latticeOccupied at all times. After save/load cycle, all state values must be exactly preserved. Undo must perfectly reverse the last growth step.
